test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the daughter of B’,

A – B means ‘A is the brother of B’,

A x B means ‘A is the wife of B’,

A ÷ B means ‘A is the father of B’.

Based on the above, how is D related to J if ‘D + F - G times H div J’ ?
